newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Itron Inc raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Itron Inc raised to buy.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth said it raised Itron Inc to a buy from a hold rating.
-- Earlier, Itron signed a letter of intent with Southern California Edison Co to develop a pilot program to read 50,000 meters using Itron's technology.
-- Dain said Itron expects to deliver the equipment in the fourth quarter of 1996, install it in the first quarter of 1997 and perform validation testing during the second quarter of 1997.
-- Itron's revenues for the project will be $5.0 million, half of which are expected to be booked in the fourth quarter.
-- Southern California Edison is a unit of Edison International.

-- "Although this is a significant victory for Itron, we regard the SoCalEd order as mainly a 1998 event," Dain said in a report. "As such, it will not by itself pull Itron out of the current financial slump caused by the year-long delay in landing big AMR (automated meter ready system) orders."

-- As a result, Dain cut its estimates for the fourth quarter of 1996 to a loss of $0.18 from a loss of $0.08; its 1996 estimate to a loss of $0.11 from a loss of $0.02 and its 1997 estimate to a profit of $0.53 from a profit of $0.59.
